## Why this change is needed

Describe the problem or research question. Link a related issue if there is one.

## What changes

Explain the resulting behaviour and any compatibility or performance effects.

## Validation

Give the commands run and their results. Note any checks that could not run and
why. For UI changes, include relevant browser/viewport checks or screenshots.

For changes to runtime assets, regenerate the standalone HTML and check it with
`node build-standalone.js --check`.

## Research evidence, if applicable

Give the exact configuration, initial multistate phase, replay command and
horizon. Explain how first return, boundary clearance, and any displacement
claim were checked. State the limits of finite-patch evidence and distinguish
new mechanisms from phase shifts or inactive rule clauses. Include the reproducible evidence supporting each claim and clearly identify
any assumptions or limitations.

## Third-party material, if applicable

Identify imported code, patterns or data and retain their source attribution and
applicable licence notices. Include an immutable upstream revision when known.
